system.notes: Stat block incomplete — description only. Serve Abyssal armies as low-status fodder. Familiar with ghosts; may have ghostly lovers, customers or masters. All inhabitants of shadowlands belong to death cults.
system.biography: Mortals living among the dead in shadowlands, serving as fodder in Abyssal armies. Positions of respect are reserved for the dead, so the living endure low status. They have the look of ghosts: pale and thin. Lives are short, diseases of Compassion are common.
